purpose: Primary certified profile. It is the runtime the committed container lock realises, and the first R release series that satisfies the pinned DESCRIPTION's Depends: R (>= 4.5.0), so an installed original can exist here at all.
supersedes_nothing: The legacy goldens under validation/golden were drawn on linux-r433-refblas. They are history and are not a certificate for this profile.

provisioning.note: The Dockerfile realises the same lock; benchmarks/container/Dockerfile is the containerised form of this profile.

laplack.note: liblapack.so.3 is a symlink to the same OpenBLAS object; extSoftVersion()[["LAPACK"]] is absent on this build, so identity is taken from the BLAS shared object that also serves LAPACK.

runtime.thread_env_note: Nested BLAS/OpenMP threads are pinned to 1 so a worker budget means workers. Benchmarks that intend more must set it explicitly and record it; the profile verifier checks the values it declares.
runtime.interpreter_note: Rscript is invoked with --vanilla so the repository's .Rprofile, which prepends /scratch/mdra00001/rlib, cannot shadow a dependency. A certified run must not pick up an unlisted library.

oracle.imports:
stats, DescTools, Hmisc, MASS, Matrix, Rdpack, doParallel,
doRNG, energy, foreach, gtools, lme4, lmerTest, multcomp,
nloptr, parallel, utils, quadprog
oracle.digest_scope_note: reference/ANCOMBC carries no .git of its own (test -d reference/ANCOMBC/.git -> absent), so reference/R/oracle.R's verify_oracle() skips its commit check entirely on this checkout. The per-file SHA-256 list above is the real pin and is what verify_profile.py enforces.
oracle.installed_identity_scope: DESCRIPTION (minus Built/Packaged/NeedsCompilation and other build metadata), NAMESPACE, and R/*.R, each hashed with its relative path.

host.core_requirement_note: P1-P4 need a stable multi-core host; 8 physical cores qualifies. P5 is defined on >= 16 physical cores and CANNOT be certified here (ENV-1). Do not read the 16 logical CPUs as satisfying it.
host.cgroup_note: ENV-2: /sys/fs/cgroup is mounted v2 with the memory controller, but mkdir is denied at the root, at user.slice and at user.slice/user-7059086.slice, and there is no sudo. P4's required peak_cgroup_memory_bytes is therefore unmeasurable here.

certification_note: Set to true only by IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md once verify_profile.py passes on this profile and every required case has been executed against the installed original in this runtime.

replacement.marker_note: R CMD INSTALL copies an inst/ directory's contents to the installed package root, so the marker is looked for there.
replacement.note: r/ancombc2rs is NOT this package and is not on its search path. The typed native bridge (crates/ancombc2-rbridge + r/ANCOMBC/src/init.c) is linked and loaded, but ancombc2() does not call it yet: S06 delivered the transport and S07-S13 deliver the stages. A loaded-but-uncalled bridge is not Rust execution and is not reported as such.
